description: Read where a domain bought with buy_domain stands: pending (registration finishing, check again in a few seconds), active (registered and connected), failed (the registrar rejected it; the charge is refunded, or support is resolving the refund), suspended or expired. null means this site's project never bought it. Before buying a domain, call skills with name "building-sites".

siteId.description: The site the domain is for, from list_sites.
